goal: Allow Bitcoin Core wallet users to send transactions to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses and bump their fees
Prevent address reuse and improve privacy for users transacting with Silent Payment recipients
reviewability: Code is otherwise ready to review
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, rustaceanrob, w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: MSVC compilation failure in walletmodel.cpp with no author reply (Yudis-bit)
Contested objection: leaf-only Taproot inputs are marked eligible and cause send failures (Yudis-bit)
Contested suggestion: inline dummy output helpers to prevent signing dummy scripts (rustaceanrob)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it adds a transaction scanning RPC without altering existing API contracts
It provides an auxiliary utility for inspecting outputs rather than serving an external consumer demand

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it brings receiver privacy and address reuse prevention to Bitcoin Core wallet users
It enables paying silent payment recipients and fee-bumping those transactions with standard wallet flows
